### What’s in a Name?
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/what-s-in-a-name-crosswalk-the-devotional-sept-23-2011.html
Passage: Revelation 2:17
Points:
- Earthly names often reflect our human desire to fit in and be accepted.
- Biblical name changes signified major spiritual turning points and renewed purposes from God.
- Placing faith in Jesus marks an immediate transformation into a child of God.
- Christ promises faithful overcomers an intimate, personal new name inscribed on a white stone.
- Believers must evaluate whether their lives and self-worth are truly defined by their identity in Christ.

### To the Church in Pergamum
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/to-the-church-in-pergamum
Passage: Revelation 2:12-17
Points:
- Pergamum was a center of imperial cults and pagan religion where Satan's influence was heavily felt.
- Christ commended the believers for holding fast under severe persecution and martyrdom.
- The congregation endangered itself by tolerating false teaching, idolatrous meals, and sexual sin.
- Jesus issued an urgent call to repent to avoid facing judgment from the sword of His mouth.
- Overcomers receive spiritual sustenance through hidden manna and a new, enduring status as God's children.
- Faithful Christians must remain vigilant against subtle worldly compromises that rival Christ.
